notes.title: New functionalities came to consoles!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Ringmasters! [/h3]

We’re delighted to share a massive console update to boost your circus’ performance!

First tested via our Open Beta feature in January, all new features are now being implemented on Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/7eced79dab0ea175d0696fb81e36db89e7dd30f3.png[/img]

[h2]What was added?[/h2]

[h3]Randomized Starting Troup[/h3]

When starting a new game, a player's troupe will be composed randomly within predefined criteria, both in the tutorial and other modes.

[h3]Artist’s Stress Effect[/h3]

Once every encounter is finished and based on its outcome one of the performing artists has the chance to receive the ‘Stressed’ effect.
[list]
[*] ‘Stress’ makes the artist unable to participate in the show until the effect is removed.
[*] ‘Stress’ is removed from the artist once 1 encounter is completed.
[/list]
[h3]Ability to Perform Shows in 3-Star Cities[/h3]

After acquiring 3 stars in any city, each player is able to play shows again within these cities on a normal basis, including cooldown between shows. However, the amount of revenue and experience will be lower.

[hr][/hr]

XBOX: https://bit.ly/circus-xbox
PS: https://bit.ly/circus-ps 
NS: https://bit.ly/TAAC-switch

notes.title: New Funtionalities in Your Circus
notes.content:
[h3]Ringmasters! 

As many of you have noticed, your beloved Circus got through the refreshment process.

As we've reached the end of OPEN BETA - where you could have personally advice us on what to improve  - we implemented the new features into the main version of the game. It means that all the refreshments are now available to each of you playing The Amazing American Circus.[/h3]


[hr][/hr]

[b]What was added[/b]: 

[h2]Randomized starting troup[/h2]

When starting a new game player's troupe will be composed randomly within predefined criteria, in both tutorial and no tutorial modes.

[h2]Artist’s stress effect[/h2]

After every encounter based on the encounter's outcome, one of the performing artists has the chance to receive the ‘Stressed’ effect.
[list]
[*] ‘Stress’ makes the artist not able to participate in the show, until effect is not removed from the artist.
[*] ‘Stress’ is removed for the artist owning the effect after 1 encounter is completed.
[/list]
[h2]Ability to play shows in the 3 star cities[/h2]

After acquiring 3 stars in any city, player should be able to play shows in such cities on a normal basis (including cooldown between shows), except the amount of revenue and experience given.

[hr][/hr]

We are really grateful for all the feedback you've provided us throughout the process of testing. According to many comments, the new features were well received and implemented the desired, deeper diversity of gameplay.

notes.title: OPEN BETA - new functionalities ahead!
notes.content:
Ringmasters of the World! 

We promised? So we will deliver brand new exciting experimental new features to your beloved Circus game are on the way! We rolled our sleeves up, counted all the juggling balls and got to work. Aaaaaand… 

*the drum roll* 
HERE IT IS! The set of new functionalities, ready to implement into the game! Well, not exactly ready, because to polish it and prepare it as satisfactory as possible, and to meet your sublime expectations, we’d like to make a small deal with you. 

[h2][u][b]BETA BRANCH[/b][/u][/h2]

To be by the book and to test all features before the final enactment, we are asking you to join our  beta available in the branch, and leave us your valuable feedback! So before we push new mechanics to public, we were sure they are what you need.

In order to change branch to Open Beta:
[olist]
[*] Right-click on the game in your Steam library.
[*] Click “Properties”.
[*] Open the “Beta” tab.
[*] Select the “Open Beta” branch.
[*] At this point the game should start updating. Good luck and have fun testing new features!
[/olist]

[h2][u][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/u][/h2]

[h3][b]Randomized starting troup[/b][/h3]

When starting a new game player's troupe will be composed r[b]andomly within predefined criteria[/b], in both tutorial and no tutorial modes.

[h3][b]Artist’s stress effect[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/80cb856b44d219bc946c9a898d6c4137780dd650.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/642110e9e4bd93814748158c408d3266756ca9cc.png[/img]

[b]After every encounter[/b] based on the encounter's outcome one of the performing artists has the chance to receive the ‘Stressed’ effect.

‘[b]Stress[/b]’ makes the artist not able to participate in the show, until effect is not removed from the artist.

‘[b]Stress[/b]’ is removed for the artist owning the effect after 1 encounter is completed.

[h3][b]Ability to play shows in the 3 star cities[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/c35f6949dcb7ab737b19ebed8d2b6c45c87b8247.png[/img]

After acquiring 3 stars in any city, player should be able to play shows in such cities on a normal basis (including cooldown between shows), except the amount of revenue and experience given.

[h2][b]FEEDBACK[/b][/h2]

The key is to check whether the features meet your expectations or not. We’ve studied the detailed requests and analized what would be the best options to implement into the gameplay to differentiate the experience. Hence the new functionalities above.

We’re kindly asking you to join our Amazing American Circus [url=https://discord.gg/wnh3PCdqNp]DISCORD[/url] server and leave your notes in the new dedicated channel there, called: #open-beta-feedback. https://discord.gg/wnh3PCdqNp We highly encourage you to use the DISCORD way of communication, though we will check your comments here, as well.

notes.title: January Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Mesdames et Messieurs, Ladies and Gentlemen!

Beware as the new patch to your beloved The Amazing American Circus will premiere today!
The new year brings fixes to what was broken, some brand new features, and a promise of a BIG new features coming later this month.[/h3]

[h3]Fixes:

Fixed all not unlocking achievements.
Fixed wrong colors of "Blessed Be Thy Chicken" reward chicken.
Clown's card  “French Drop" now counts all cards in the Players hand correctly.
Fixed Conjoined Twins special effect not being applied on Player's troupe.[/h3]

[h3]Important! Due to an internal error, we had changed save files localization in the last patch. If you have played recently and want to keep your progress - follow the below steps. If you haven’t played before 17th December - your save files should work fine. [/h3]

Locate your save files in C:\Users\<your username>\AppData\LocalLow\Klabater\The Amazing American Circus
Locate files with .dat extension (save0.dat, save1.dat, save2.dat)
Select and move those files to the ‘Saves’ folder. (C:\Users\<your username>\AppData\LocalLow\Klabater\The Amazing American Circus\Saves)
Make sure that the ‘Saves’ folder contains fogOfWarX.png files. 

[h3]New features:
Adjustable speed of animation[/h3]

You can now adjust the speed of animations played when casting cards and finales. We received many requests to add this feature to make The Amazing American Circus gameplay faster and smoother, and now we are delighted to confirm - we did it! You can access this feature in the game settings menu and use a  toolbar “Performance speed” to control animation speed, increasing them by 100% to 200%. The speed can be adjusted in any way anytime during the game.

[h3]More new features coming! [/h3]

The below features are currently “work-in-progress.” However, we expect to make them available as a beta branch to You all for testing still in January. We deliver them in late January or early February if met with positive feedback, so stay tuned for the following announcement coming ETA mid-January.

[h3]Randomized starting troupe[/h3]

When starting a new game, your troupe of artists will be composed randomly within predefined criteria. This will allow more fantastic replayability and encourage players to experiment with a wider choice of artists.

[h3]Artist’s stress effect[/h3]

After every given show based on the show outcome, one of the performing artists can receive the ‘Stressed’ effect. ‘Stress’ will make the artist unable to participate in the next show until the effect is not removed/ cured. The main goal of the feature is to encourage the rotation of the troupe members between the shows.

[h3]Perform Shows in the cities (endlessly)[/h3]

After performing max 3 stars in any city, You still would be able to perform there regularly (including cooldown between shows).

[h3]Steam Cloud Saves[/h3]

Self-explanatory, support of Steam Cloud Saves will be added for greater comfort.

notes.title: The Amazing Christmas Patch!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Ringmasters all over the world! 

It is not by chance we’re greeting you this way today. We’re coming to you with a bunch of really good news - all related to what’s going to change in the Circus. Frankly saying, even we are impressed that all these things could have been synchronized into one big patch. And just like Santa coming to all good children, quickly and mysteriously, we’re gonna give you a present, in a few places at the same moment. [/h3]

[h2]But what do we mean by that?[/h2]

Well, the incoming patch is fixing many bugs. According to your precious reports, many of them were localization-related, and a few of them were simply about the wrong text in the wrong places or general lack of dialogues. So now, when you decide to change the language during your gameplay, you will not encounter any localization snags. You can find the full list of patch notes below.

[h2]And what’s the most important gift in The Amazing American Santa’s sack this Christmas?[/h2]

TRADING CARDS! Starting today, you will have a chance to gather not only the incredible troupe of artists in the game but also you will build your unique Steam deck with those special trading cards. Each of them represents one artist that you encounter during your travel throughout America. 

The aim is to become The Greatest Showman on Earth, that’s for sure. But nothing stands in the way to obtain some exclusive badges and take part in the Steam Card Exchange.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/a9384022c62d4f2c1ec71384f25abd82182142df.png[/img]

[h3]PATCH NOTES:[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Fixed character image dialogue visibility in the quest  "By Flood and by Fire".
[*] Fixed character image and dialogue visibility in quest “Investor’s Quarrel”.
[*] Fixed the VO of Beggar in Topeka.
[*] CONTINUE button is replaced with LOAD GAME.
[*] When the cards are drawn they are no longer visible horizontally.
[*] The audience descriptions in the journal appear in the correct language after going to the menu.
[*] Max Fame Star indicator is now showing the correct number in every region.
[*] You can now see the Wagon tutorials in quest cities.
[*] Fixed bug with achievements: "Making it hard on yourself" and "Last Man Standing"
[/list]

Christmas time is coming and you gave us plenty of feedback on what's to fix. In return, we are happy to give you this patch. As always, we are counting on your flowing comments on whether everything works top-notch here!

notes.title: THE AMAZING AMERICAN CIRCUS GAINS FULL PAD CONTROLLER SUPPORT
notes.content:
Salute Ringmasters! 

[h2]Today we have a decent piece of news for you, regarding the controls and UI in our game. [/h2]

Along with this patch, we’re adding full pad controller support into the PC version of The Amazing American Circus. It means if you’ll ever want to experience the good ol’ circus adventure using your favorite controller, then the opportunity just arose! 

Additionally, while switching from keyboard to pad, the whole in-game interface will change and reflect the ‘console’ approach. So, from now on, whatever you choose, be it keyboard and mouse or pad/controller, you’ll meet no obstacles while managing your camp, because the support of Unity Universal Controller is on the flight. 

[h3]So briefly, what's been added: [/h3]
- Main (Camp) UI adjusted
- Changed the way the information about character buffs/effects is displayed (you can hover over characters/enemies to get a summary of the effects)
- Added controller support


We do hope that those changes will make your gameplay more pleasant.

notes.title: Promised Content Incoming
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Friends! 

One week ago the Circus finally came to town! Since that time, we have received some nice reviews & scores (around 30 now with a median of 7 out of 10!!!). Our Steam user score is 75% positive which is very cool, but that doesn’t mean there’s no place for improvements! [/h3]

Hence, we release the patch yesterday. Thank you all for participating in the debut and helping in shaping our big top the way it is now. 

Along with the patch comes [b]Lore Book[/b] (also being a part of some Kickstarter campaign pledges), a promised part of Ringmaster’s Edition… and so it lands! The team of artists responsible for The Amazing American Circus was inspired by many art styles and works of art related to the US Gilded Age, but you will also surely discover comic book inspirations and even similarities to the old-school tattoo styles! That’s why we wanted to share with you a special lore book, 100 pages filled with all that’s quaint and fascinating. Ready to immerse the audience in the whole lore of what our Circus truly is. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/4fb2bbf871e9cf8ea3f752b280a986a4f01d1f24.jpg[/img]
[h2]Last but not least - [b]Patch Notes[/b].[/h2]

Achievement fixes:
- Fixed achievement: From the bottom of the lake,
- Fixed achievement: Making it hard on yourself,
- Fixed achievement: Last man standing,
- All achievements are now visible on Steam.

Random events fixes:
- Fixed the placeholders texts appearing in South Region,
- Fixed text in the event “All that glitters“.

- Wagon names now fit,
- Fixed the problem with looping music,
- Fixed the problem with not fitting texts during dialogues, which put occasionally character’s name instead of graphic,
- Special Attraction “Umbrella, ela, ela…” now fit in the window confirming obtaining Special Attraction.

[hr][/hr]
The show must go on, and so do our work on The Amazing American Circus. We are grateful for your support!!!

Klabater and Juggler Games team!

notes.title: Community Update!
notes.content:
Hey All, a quick update so you know what's going on with our game! And there's a lot happening every day!

Before we get into other details, we are now working on a Story Trailer and in-game cut scenes. Please catch these fresh and neat artworks! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/e7ed88e8b5134702429a84ef4ba4ef251dae02c3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/7149650c1a6cf2b5c18df1bcf3e0f61927f4f6d5.jpg[/img]

[b]--> BETA TESTS[/b]: We had an internal dev team meeting yesterday. We are getting closed to finalize the beta build which will be available to our dear Kickstarter backers at first.  But we do think about the 2nd stage open to other gamers, please stay tuned. To get more info on beta tests, please make sure you visit our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/zJxgnMguvY

Just so you know, we decided to change and upgrade many UI elements lately and we really want to implement it before you guys check the game!

[b]--> Kickstarter update[/b]: We are now gathering all the info from your Kickstarter surveys. We will try to deliver codes to our other games (Klabater/Juggler) as soon as we have the most data in one place! We know you guys are waiting, but fulfilling Kickstarter is not an easy task, we need to plan everything carefully:) 

[b]--> DEV STREAMS[/b]: We do plan to launch some preview streams on our Steam card probably next week or so. Our community will be on top of that soon. Expect more news in the upcoming days! We will stream the game on our Steam card of course! 

And, since you made it this far, please check completely new screens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/79750b50d7f0fb28538c562ce8ba1fd4f4d84cb5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/439ebdf8a69d29690f1a18e0a507411a16b7d2b5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/72760b29f6e1346282a734155bae951fa538349c.jpg[/img]

See this hairy fellow? Well, he is not very talkative, but will make a strong addition to your troupe! If you want to make a legendary [b]Bigfoot[/b] one of your artists, you need to show him the magic of the circus first! A stunning performance will do! 

Thanks for supporting us! As always, if you have any questions just let us know!

Klabater team
